title: Web app usage
description: Usage, changes, errors, and replays for the apps behind the otel-poc proxy.

panels.title: Page views
panels.description: Route changes inside the app count as page views too.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", service AS "breakdown_1", count(distinct view_id) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", service_name AS "breakdown_1", count(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'click' AND (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC
SELECT count(distinct session_id) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "_rumdata" WHERE (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app))

panels.title: Typical session
panels.description: Median time from first to last event in a session.

queries.query: SELECT median(length) / 1e6 AS "y_axis_1" FROM ( SELECT session_id, max(_timestamp) - min(_timestamp) AS length FROM "_rumdata" WHERE (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY session_id)

panels.title: Time on page
panels.description: Time each page stayed open, query string dropped. A tab left open counts the whole time, so the median is the fairer number.

queries.query: SELECT service AS "app", page, count(*) AS "views", median(spent) / 1e9 AS "median_time", sum(spent) / 1e9 AS "total_time" FROM (SELECT service, view_id, regexp_replace(view_url, '^https?://[^/]+|[?][^#]*', '', 'g') AS page, max(view_time_spent) AS spent FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY service, view_id, page) GROUP BY app, page ORDER BY total_time DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT user_agent_user_agent_family AS "x_axis_1", count(distinct session_id) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "_rumdata" WHERE (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1

SELECT service_name AS "app", page_path AS "page", target_element AS "element", target_text AS "control", count(*) AS "uses" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name IN ('click', 'change', 'submit') AND target_text <> '' AND target_element NOT IN ('BODY', 'HTML') AND (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY app, page, element, control ORDER BY uses DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Least-used controls
panels.description: Controls used at least once. Ones nobody touched need a feature list to show up.

queries.query: SELECT service_name AS "app", page_path AS "page", target_element AS "element", target_text AS "control", count(*) AS "uses" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name IN ('click', 'change', 'submit') AND target_text <> '' AND target_element NOT IN ('BODY', 'HTML') AND (service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY app, page, element, control ORDER BY uses ASC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Changes made through the apps
panels.description: Requests that changed something. Kubernetes permission checks and Redpanda Console reads are POSTs too, so they're left out.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp AS "time", app, method, uri AS "path", status, client FROM "nginx_access" WHERE method NOT IN ('GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS') AND NOT regexp_like(uri, 'reviews([?].*)?$') AND NOT regexp_like(uri, '^/redpanda[.][^?]*/(List|Get|Describe|Check|Validate|Lint)[A-Za-z]*([?].*)?$') AND (app IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent sessions
panels.description: Click a row to open its replay.

queries.query: SELECT session_id, service AS "app", min(_timestamp) AS "started", (max(_timestamp) - min(_timestamp)) / 1e6 AS "length", count(distinct CASE WHEN type = 'view' THEN view_id END) AS "views", count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'error') AS "errors", min(_timestamp) AS "start_us", max(_timestamp) AS "end_us" FROM "_rumdata" WHERE (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY session_id, app ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", app AS "breakdown_1", count(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "nginx_access" WHERE status >= 500 AND (app IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", service AS "breakdown_1", count(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'error' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1 ASC

SELECT service AS "app", substr(error_message, 1, 160) AS "message", count(*) AS "times", count(distinct session_id) AS "sessions" FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'error' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY app, message ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Slowest requests (p95)
panels.description: Build files and websockets left out. A websocket's time is how long it stayed open.

queries.query: SELECT app, regexp_replace(uri, '[?].*$', '') AS "path", count(*) AS "requests", round(approx_percentile_cont(request_time, 0.95) * 1000) AS "p95_ms", round(avg(request_time) * 1000) AS "avg_ms", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status >= 500) AS "errors_5xx" FROM "nginx_access" WHERE (app IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) AND upgrade = '' AND NOT regexp_like(uri, '^/(assets|static|static-plugins)/') GROUP BY app, path ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 25
